# Nexora

> Nexora is a business intelligence platform that connects business data, explains what is changing, and helps teams decide what to do next.

## Product

- Business overview: connected metrics and business signals.
- Business Brain: explainable signals, risks, opportunities, and business context.
- Data Hub: designed for importing business data and mapping it into useful business context.

## Public pages

- / — Product overview
- /about — About Nexora
- /contact — Contact Nexora

## Product status

Nexora is in product development. Public claims should be based only on information published on the Nexora website.
